\chapter{Problem Index}
\label{ch:problem-index}

Every problem in the book appears exactly once: as a fully solved problem, an exercise of a pattern, a practice-set problem, or a variant of a solved problem. 138 problems in total --- 49 from LeetCode, 65 from Codeforces, 20 from AtCoder, 4 from CSES. Click a title to open the problem on its judge; click the page number to jump to it in the book. Codeforces problems are sorted by rating, the others by their number.

\begin{center}\small
\textbf{Where:} \textit{Problem} = fully solved (four approaches) \quad \textit{Exercise} = end of a pattern, full solution \quad \textit{Practice} = chapter problem set, design sketch \\ \textit{Variant} = one change to a solved problem: subproblem and recurrence in the Variants box
\end{center}
